> 第二十一章 父子情（第1页）
深夜幕降临，台焕一行人扎营在台城外的一处山坡上，明日便将进城。
白雀神白舞为了让大家放松心神，主动唱起歌来。清亮的嗓音在夜风中流淌，勾起每个人心底最美好的回忆。
鹰捷枕着小青鹰，梦见鹰城的风车重新转动，父亲鹰长空站在塔楼上朝他微笑。
俄莹抱着雪瞳兽，梦见俄城的星光重新亮起，父亲俄擎苍骑着北辰为她指引方向。
明玥倚着沧渊贝，梦见母亲明沧澜在海边捡贝壳，轻声说：“玥儿，你是海的女儿。”台灵偎依在哥哥身边，梦见台城的庭院里，父亲台振岳蹲在花圃前，教她辨认花草；哥哥在练武场上挥剑，汗水在阳光下闪闪发光。
众人都沉沉睡去。唯有台焕辗转难眠。快能救出父亲了——可父亲却成了敌人。
这个念头让他心如刀绞，无论如何也无法入眠。他起身，独自走到附近的树林中散步。
月光透过枝叶洒下斑驳的光影。他思绪起伏，脑海中全是父亲的身影。
“焕儿。”一个熟悉的声音从身后传来。台焕浑身一震，猛然回头。月光下，一个高大的身影立在不远处——正是他的父亲，台振岳。
“父亲！”台焕惊喜交加，快步迎上，
“您……您逃出来了？”台振岳缓缓走近，脸上带着淡淡的笑意。
“是啊，魔盟主的牢笼困不住我。”他伸手，拍了拍儿子的肩膀，
“你长大了，焕儿。”台焕眼眶发热，一时不知该说什么。然而，下一句话，让他如坠冰窟。
“焕儿，归顺魔盟主吧。”台振岳平静道，
“这是唯一的生路。”台焕僵住了。
“魔盟主的力量无可匹敌。”台振岳的声音依旧温和，却透着不容置疑的冰冷，
“与他对抗，只有死路一条。只要你肯归顺，他承诺保留台城，让我们父子继续治理这片土地。”台焕后退一步，死死盯着父亲的脸。
那张脸依然是记忆中的模样，可那双眼睛里，已没有曾经的温暖。

“父亲，您教过我，”他的声音发颤，
“无论面对什么，都要坚守正义。”台振岳的眉头微微皱起。
“焕儿，你太天真了。”他抬手，一股无形的压力骤然笼罩台焕！台焕踉跄后退，手无寸铁——道晶兽还在营地。
“道晶兽变身！”金鳞神兵兽落在台焕肩头，瞬间化作道晶剑落入掌中。
“我不是你父亲。”台振岳冷冷道，
“至少，不是那个教你愚蠢正义的父亲。”他抬手虚抓，劲风扑面！台焕挥剑格挡，却只守不攻，步步后退。
剑光与掌风交织，他一次次被震退，却始终不肯刺出那一剑。
“还手！”台振岳厉喝。台焕咬紧牙关，剑尖低垂。他怎么能对自己的父亲出手？
掌风擦过脸颊，留下一道血痕。他踉跄几步，险些跌倒。
“住手！”莉亚·塞莱娜的声音从身后传来。鹰捷、台灵、俄莹、明玥、星璃纷纷赶到，白雀神白舞落在众人肩头。
“白舞，快唱歌唤醒他！”莉亚·塞莱娜急声道。白雀神白舞清亮的嗓音响起，一首温柔的歌谣飘入台振岳耳中。
然而，台振岳只是微微一顿，随即冷笑。
“没用的。”他指了指自己的耳朵，
“魔盟主早有准备——这耳塞，隔绝一切外音。”众人这才注意到，他耳中隐隐可见两粒黑色的东西。
台振岳负手而立，目光扫过众人，最后落在台焕身上。
“焕儿，我给你时间考虑。”他转身，向黑暗中走去，
“父亲——！”台焕的声音在夜风中颤抖。台振岳没有回头。他的身影渐渐融入黑暗，消失不见。
台焕跪倒在地，道晶剑跌落身侧。他望着父亲消失的方向，眼泪无声滑落。

> Chapter 21 Father-son love (page 1)
Late at night, Tai Huan and his party camped on a hillside outside Taicheng, and would enter the city tomorrow.
In order to relax everyone's mind, Baiwu, the White Sparrow God, took the initiative to sing. The clear voice flows in the night wind, bringing back the best memories in everyone's heart.
Ying Jie rested his head on Little Qing Ying, dreaming that the windmill in Ying City was turning again, and his father Ying Changkong stood on the tower and smiled at him.
Oying held the snow-eyed beast in her arms and dreamed that the stars in Oicheng were lighting up again, and her father Oqingcang rode Beichen to guide her in the direction.
Ming Yue leaned on the Cang Yuan shell and dreamed of her mother Ming Cang Lan picking up shells at the beach and whispered: "Yue'er, you are the daughter of the sea." Tai Ling snuggled next to her brother and dreamed of her father Tai Zhenyue squatting in front of the flower bed in Taicheng, teaching her how to identify flowers and plants; her brother wielding a sword on the martial arts field, sweat glistening in the sun.
Everyone fell into a deep sleep. Only Tai Huan could not sleep. He was almost able to rescue his father - but his father became an enemy.
This thought made his heart beat like a knife, and he couldn't sleep no matter what. He got up and went for a walk alone in the nearby woods.
The moonlight casts mottled light and shadow through the branches and leaves. His thoughts were up and down, and his father's figure was all in his mind.
"Huan'er." A familiar voice came from behind. Tai Huan was shocked and turned around suddenly. Under the moonlight, a tall figure stood not far away - it was his father, Tai Zhenyue.
"Father!" Tai Huan was overjoyed and rushed to greet him.
"You...you escaped?" Tai Zhenyue slowly approached, with a faint smile on his face.
"Yes, the Demon Alliance Leader's prison cannot trap me." He reached out and patted his son on the shoulder.
"You have grown up, Huan'er." Tai Huan's eyes were hot and he didn't know what to say. However, the next words made him feel as if he had fallen into an ice cave.
"Huan'er, surrender to the leader of the Demon Alliance." Tai Zhenyue said calmly,
"This is the only way to survive." Tai Huan froze.
"The power of the Demon Alliance Leader is unmatched." Tai Zhenyue's voice was still gentle, but it was undeniably cold.
"Fighting him will lead to death. As long as you are willing to surrender, he promises to keep Taicheng and let us father and son continue to govern this land." Tai Huan took a step back and stared at his father's face.
The face still looked the same as in the memory, but the warmth in those eyes no longer existed.
"Father, you taught me," his voice trembled,
"No matter what you face, you must stick to justice." Tai Zhenyue frowned slightly.
"Huan'er, you are too naive." He raised his hand, and an invisible pressure suddenly enveloped Tai Huan! Tai Huan staggered back, defenseless—the Dao Crystal Beast was still in the camp.
"Transformation of the Dao Crystal Beast!" The golden-scaled Divine Weapon Beast landed on Tai Huan's shoulder, and instantly turned into a Dao Crystal Sword and fell into his palm.
"I'm not your father." Tai Zhenyue said coldly,
"At least, it's not the father who taught you stupid justice." He raised his hand to grasp it, and the strong wind hit his face! Tai Huan waved his sword to block, but he only defended and did not attack, and retreated step by step.
The sword light intertwined with the palm wind, and he was knocked back time and time again, but he still refused to thrust out the sword.
"Fight back!" Tai Zhenyue shouted fiercely. Tai Huan gritted his teeth and lowered the tip of his sword. How could he take action against his father?
The wind from his palm grazed his cheek, leaving a trail of blood. He staggered a few steps and almost fell.
"Stop!" Leah Selena's voice came from behind. Yingjie, Tailing, Erying, Mingyue, and Xingli arrived one after another, and Baique Shen Baiwu landed on everyone's shoulders.
"Bai Wu, sing quickly to wake him up!" Leah Selena said urgently. Bai Que Shen Bai Wu's clear voice sounded, and a gentle ballad floated into Tai Zhenyue's ears.
However, Tai Zhenyue only paused slightly and then sneered.
"It's useless." He pointed to his ears.
"The leader of the Demon Alliance has been prepared for a long time - this earBlock, block out all external sounds. "Only then did everyone notice that two black things were faintly visible in his ears.
Tai Zhenyue stood with his hands behind his back, his eyes swept over everyone, and finally fell on Tai Huan.
"Huan'er, I'll give you time to think about it. "He turned around and walked into the darkness,
"Father——! "Tai Huan's voice trembled in the night wind. Tai Zhenyue did not look back. His figure gradually merged into the darkness and disappeared.
Tai Huan fell to his knees and the Daojing Sword fell to his side. He looked at the direction where his father disappeared and tears fell silently.
